# Database Logging & SQL Observability Checklist: SisPatrimonio

**Purpose**: Requirements quality validation ("Unit Tests for English") for database operation logging, query visibility during application use, and clean output for academic demonstration.
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for capturing and displaying SELECT queries in logs when listing assets, categories, or locations in the application? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for capturing and displaying INSERT queries in logs when registering new assets, categories, or movements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for capturing and displaying UPDATE and soft-delete queries in logs during asset modifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements specified for displaying the execution time / duration in milliseconds alongside each executed query? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements documented for filtering out repetitive automated Docker healthcheck queries (`SELECT 1`) from the log output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements specified for environment-based activation and toggling via configuration (`LOG_SQL_STATEMENTS`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity & Specificity

- [x] CHK007 Is the visual log format (prefix, SQL statement, parameters, elapsed duration) explicitly quantified and defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Is the concept of "clean/unpolluted log" defined with concrete exclusion and formatting rules rather than subjective descriptors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Is the default state of `LOG_SQL_STATEMENTS` in development vs production environments unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Security & Sensitive Data Handling

- [x] CHK010 Are requirements specified for identifying which database columns and parameters contain sensitive credentials (e.g. `password_hash`)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the replacement token (`[REDACTED]`) for sanitized query parameters unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec define whether queries that fail with database errors still redact sensitive bind parameters in failure logs? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are logging requirements specified for explicit transaction boundary events (`BEGIN`, `COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK`)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK014 Are logging requirements defined for multi-statement bulk operations (e.g. database seed or spreadsheet import)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements specified for logging behavior when executing under SQLite fallback during automated unit tests? [Consistency, Spec §Constraints]
- [x] CHK016 Does the spec specify whether Alembic migration DDL queries should be included or excluded from this application-level listener? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK017 Can the outcome "100% das operações SQL geradas pelas rotas da API são visualizáveis de forma legível" be objectively measured and verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK018 Is there an objective criterion for confirming that zero automated healthcheck queries leak into the presentation log? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
